name: Etherfuse CETES
oneLiner: CETES is Etherfuse's tokenized fund tracking short-term Mexican federal Treasury bonds, NAV-accruing in MXN and redeemable through KYC'd subscription.
collateral: Short-term Mexican federal government bonds (CETES — Certificados de la Tesorería de la Federación), BBB- rated sovereign debt with maturities set by government auctions; held in segregated custody through INDEVAL (Instituto para el Depósito de Valores) via participating brokerages
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting token; price starts near MXN 1.00 and appreciates continuously as zero-coupon CETES bonds discount to face value; bonds rolled at each maturity date; subscription and redemption through Etherfuse at current NAV; KYC required

mintAuthority.summary: CETES is issued by Etherfuse as a NAV-accreting tokenized fund. On Solana the mintAuthority is a 1-of-2 SPL Token-2022 multisig controlled by Etherfuse; on Base/Polygon the owner is a single EOA also holding the proxy admin upgrade path.

controls.label: Etherfuse issuance backend
controls.evidence: Etherfuse mints CETES on KYC'd subscription and burns on redemption at NAV against CETES bonds custodied via INDEVAL; supply creation is issuer-controlled with no permissionless route.

controls.label: CETES Base/Polygon owner EOA + proxy admin
controls.evidence: At Base block 47200682 and Polygon (2026-06-11): owner() on 0x834df4c1d8f51be24322e39e4766697be015512f returned 0xf0a5e0932f2a648dbe6e5089ea37e178dc16600f on both chains; eth_getCode on that address = 2 bytes (EOA confirmed). EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0x322922f0e1675a8e7be2a38b0636a7c184082ca8 (ProxyAdmin contract), whose owner() also returns 0xf0a5e0... (same EOA). EIP-1967 implementation slot = 0xd2acc459fd2a8f2ef7a42bff1e61b8d9dc71b678. The same EOA controls both the token role and the upgrade path.

review.evidence: Solana: CETES mintAuthority confirmed as 1-of-2 SPL Token-2022 multisig (A6nFyQb...) with 2 Etherfuse-operated signers. Base/Polygon: owner = EOA 0xf0a5e0... (also owns the ProxyAdmin at 0x322922...). The EOA controls both ownership and upgrade rights on EVM chains.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Etherfuse documents per-chain asset setup and mint/burn style issuance through its platform for supported assets including CETES. No independent bridge route is required in the reviewed public docs, so Pharos treats it as issuer-native multichain issuance.
